title: Builder Signals · 2026-10-23
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 36 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 12 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Claude · Anthropic 官方账号
featured.summaryEn: Anthropic introduced Claude Duet, built around Claude Opus 5.5, which decides what needs you, what can wait, and when to check with you first. It carries over memory, skills, and connected apps from your Claude account, so setup is minimal. On safety, Duet never directly sees your passwords, a new classifier guards against sharing sensitive information, and important decisions stay with the user. It is an early research preview via waitlist for Pro and Max plans in the US, and Anthropic acknowledges it can still m…
featured.insightZh: Anthropic 官方介绍了 Claude Duet：它围绕 Claude Opus 5.5 设计，由模型判断哪些事需要你处理、哪些可以等、什么时候先征求你同意；会沿用你 Claude 账号里的记忆、技能和已连接应用，几乎不需要额外配置。安全方面，Duet 不会直接看到你的密码，新增的分类器防止泄露敏感信息，重要决策仍由用户做。目前是早期研究预览版，仅面向美国的 Pro / Max 用户，需排队申请，官方也承认它仍可能误判事情的紧急程度。

featured.title: Cat Wu · Anthropic Claude Code / Cowork 产品负责人
featured.summaryEn: Cat Wu framed Duet as a response to user feedback that people want Claude to proactively take more off their plate. Duet notices work that needs doing and does it before you ask, which she calls a large step in that direction.
featured.insightZh: Cat Wu 说 Duet 是对用户反馈的回应——大家希望 Claude 主动替自己多承担一些工作。Duet 会自己发现需要做的事，并在你开口之前就把它做掉，她称这是朝这个方向迈出的一大步。

featured.title: How a Frontier Team Can Help Your Company Keep Up With AI
featured.summaryEn: Keeping up with AI is now a full-time job, so companies need a dedicated Frontier Team that tracks the model frontier and runs experiments while everyone else uses what's proven — and success is measured by integration, not by the number of experiments. Every CEO Dan Shipper and head of enterprise AI adoption Natalia interviewed members of Every's Frontier Team. Dan describes the dilemma every employee faces: ignore the frontier and risk disruption by an agent-native competitor, or chase shiny objects and never build anything lasting. The Frontier Team separates these concerns. It pairs "pirates," who move fast and try many things, with "architects," who compress messy experiments into maintainable systems, plus a "Wrangler" (Arielle Shipper) who maps experiments to themes, turns them into content, products and consulting concepts, and built a token usage dashboard broken down by person…
featured.insightZh: 跟上 AI 已是全职工作，企业应设立专门的「Frontier Team」负责追踪模型前沿、做实验，其他人只负责使用经过验证的成果——关键不在实验数量，而在能否落地并被组织吸收。 Every CEO Dan Shipper 与企业 AI 采纳负责人 Natalia 逐一访谈了 Every 的 Frontier Team 成员。Dan 指出每个员工都面临两难：要么埋头干活被 Agent 原生的竞品颠覆，要么追新工具却建不出持久的东西。Frontier Team 把两者拆开。团队里有两种角色：「海盗」快速试错、几天试上千种东西；「架构师」把混乱的实验压缩成可维护、可推广的系统。此外还有「Wrangler」（Arielle Shipper）负责把实验归纳成主题、转化为内容、产品和咨询方法论，并做了 token 用量仪表盘，按人、按工作类别统计花费以判断投入产出。 评测负责人 Mike Taylor 帮同事建立个人 benchmark，并展示了用 Opus 的最高强度模式调动数百个 Agent 读完他所有 Slack 消息和会议纪要，自动剪出一条可溯源的产品讲解视频。他的建议：大胆把全部上下文交给 AI；同时产出变多后，「保护别人的注意力」成了新职责。高级编辑 Jack Cheng 自建了无标签页浏览器并内置可切换模型的 Agent 面板；驻站作者 Katie Parrott 给写作插件加入 audience.md 描述目标读者；工程师 Jannik Jung 展示自建编排器 Minga，在目标和计划层面工作而非单个编码会话；Kieran Klaassen 回顾模型能力演进，强调 Frontier Team 的核心是「集成」——一百个实验扔进频道没人用等于没做。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Dan Shipper's team tested Duet for two weeks and calls it the first personal agent he'd consider a pro tool; he went from mostly ChatGPT to roughly 50/50 between ChatGPT and Claude. Strengths: a separate app on iOS, Android and web, channels for distinct areas of work and life, a todo list with statuses, and in-app document and slide editing. Gaps: it's not a chief of staff yet — it can see Claude sessions on his computers but can't direct them, its email drafts trail dot's, and voice is transcription-only. Verdic…
items.insightZh: Dan Shipper 团队已内测 Duet 两周，评价是「第一个我愿意称为专业工具的个人 Agent」，他自己从主要用 ChatGPT 变成了 ChatGPT 与 Claude 大约五五开。亮点：独立 App（iOS / Android / Web）、按工作和生活领域划分的 channel、带状态的 todo 列表、可直接写和改文档与幻灯片。短板：还算不上「幕僚长」——能看到电脑上的 Claude 会话但无法调度它们，邮件草稿不如 dot，语音只能转写不能对话。结论是值得一试。另外他发布了 Every 内部「Frontier Team」的视频：让一个专门团队负责跟进模型变化，其他人只用他们的成果（详见下方 Podcast）。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 创始人、OpenAI
items.summaryEn: Peter Steinberger revealed that the PHP vulnerability expected to cause havoc this week was found with GPT‑5.6 Sol — another concrete example of AI-driven vulnerability discovery moving from concept to practice.
items.insightZh: Peter Steinberger 透露：本周将造成大面积冲击的那个 PHP 漏洞，是用 GPT‑5.6 Sol 发现的。这是「AI 挖漏洞」从概念走向实战的又一个具体例证。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Rauch posted three updates: Vercel rolled out firewall-level mitigations for today's Node.js RCE ahead of the official patch, protecting all deployments automatically while rolling out managed runtime upgrades; the industry coordinated weeks in advance on php2shell, and Vercel's WAF has already blocked attempts on PHP origins — "assume more vulnerabilities are on the way, flex the patch → redeploy muscle"; and DeepSeek v4.1 Flash is now in Vercel's Token Pass — fast, very cheap, zero data retention, ideal for suba…
items.insightZh: Rauch 连发三条：其一，在 Node.js 官方补丁发布前，Vercel 已主动上线防火墙级缓解措施，所有部署的流量自动受保护，并正在推送托管运行时升级；其二，行业提前数周协作应对 php2shell，Vercel WAF 已成功拦截针对 PHP 源站的攻击尝试，他提醒「后面还会有更多漏洞，练好 patch → redeploy 的肌肉」；其三，DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 已纳入 Vercel Token Pass，速度快、价格极低、零数据保留，适合作为执行大模型计划的 subagent。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Levie argues cyber will be one of AI's most profound arenas: a tireless workforce can now hunt, discover, patch, or attack any system. Attackers and defenders will both use agents, ushering in a new cyber regime that may consume 100x more tokens than expected, since every log, line of code, and traffic flow can be scanned. He adds that if you want to know which jobs AI will create, look at cybersecurity — even as work becomes agentic, you'll need talent to point agents at critical work, review findings, patch syst…
items.insightZh: Levie 认为网络安全会是 AI 最深远的影响领域之一：我们现在有了不知疲倦的「劳动力」，可以搜寻、发现、修补或攻击任何系统。攻防双方都会用 Agent，安全进入新阶段，这个循环消耗的 token 可能比想象多 100 倍，因为可以扫描每一行日志、每一行代码和全部流量。他还指出，若想知道 AI 会创造哪些工作，看安全就够了——即便工作越来越 Agent 化，仍需要人去指挥 Agent 处理最关键的工作、审核发现、打补丁和应急响应。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons GP、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: Aditya noticed his son watched Star Wars for about 3 hours but spent about 20 hours building games about it with AI — and barely played them, preferring the act of building. He suggests making things with AI may be as fun as using it, and the joy of programming, once limited to a few, may now be open to everyone. On the PHP vulnerability: "It's always PHP."
items.insightZh: Aditya 观察到一个有意思的现象：儿子看了约 3 小时《星球大战》，却花了约 20 小时用 AI 做相关游戏，做好后几乎不怎么玩，更享受「造」本身。他认为用 AI 创造和「使用」AI 一样有趣，编程的乐趣过去只属于少数人，现在也许每个人都能体验到。对于 PHP 漏洞，他的吐槽是「永远是 PHP」。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark Capital 合伙人
items.summaryEn: Two Matt Turck portfolio companies announced Series E rounds this week: Pigment raised $250M and Legora raised $550M. He argues that in an era of tokens, APIs and agents, enterprises are shifting to continuous financial planning, and Pigment is the platform for it (FirstMark invested since seed).
items.insightZh: Matt Turck 所投的两家公司本周相继宣布 E 轮：财务规划平台 Pigment 融资 2.5 亿美元，法律 AI 公司 Legora 融资 5.5 亿美元。他认为在 token、API 和 Agent 的时代，企业正转向「持续财务规划」，Pigment 正是为此而生（FirstMark 自种子轮起投资）。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder、Follow Builders 作者
items.summaryEn: Zara argued that your personal website is the new resume, and shared a one-prompt project that turns a photo into a 3D pop-up card, with the prompt included.
items.insightZh: Zara 提出「个人网站就是新的简历」，并分享了一个单条 prompt 就能把照片变成 3D 立体弹出卡片的小作品，附上了完整 prompt。

items.title: Google Labs · Google AI 实验产品
items.summaryEn: Google Labs released Part 2 of "Dreambeans Roulette," covering how Dreambeans stories are "brewed," how to make them "dream" better, and what it would mean to design apps that get you off your phone. Dreambeans is live in the US for users 18+.
items.insightZh: Google Labs 发布「Dreambeans Roulette」系列第二集，讨论 Dreambeans 故事是如何「酿造」出来的、怎样让它「梦」得更好，以及「如果 App 的设计目标是让你放下手机」会怎样。Dreambeans 已在美国面向 18 岁以上用户上线。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Garry Tan criticized UC Berkeley economist Gabriel Zucman, an adviser to the union sponsoring California's Prop. 40 who contributed research to its revenue estimates and campaigns for it. Tan claims the measure would cause a roughly $39B net loss to the state, hurting public universities like Zucman's own, and says "his ideas will destroy California."
items.insightZh: Garry Tan 抨击 UC Berkeley 经济学家 Gabriel Zucman：Zucman 是支持加州 Prop. 40 提案的工会的经济顾问，参与了提案收入测算的研究并公开为其站台。Garry 认为该提案将导致加州州财政净损失约 390 亿美元，反过来伤害公立大学本身，称「他的想法会毁掉加州」。
